Flo Health is a science-backed cycle, ovulation, pregnancy, and period tracker with over 570 million downloads worldwide.*

Track your period (regular or irregular), predict ovulation, learn to spot fertile signs, follow your baby’s growth with Flo Health’s pregnancy tracker, and explore perimenopause symptoms. Flo Health is here to support your menstrual cycle and female health journey.

Why choose Flo Health for period and ovulation tracking?
Flo Health is more than a basic calendar — it's a period tracker and ovulation tracker designed to help you notice patterns over time.

- Over 70 trackable symptoms and moods to receive personalized menstrual cycle insights
- Support for irregular periods, pre-period symptoms, and cycle changes
- Cycle report summaries you can download and share with your doctor
- Flori: Well-Being Battery that gives you a snapshot of how your sleep, cycle, activity, and symptoms may be impacting you

Can Flo Health support my trying-to-conceive (TTC) journey?
Flo Health offers educational features to help you explore conception insights and better understand how to spot fertile signs.

- Fertile window and ovulation predictions based on your logged period data
- Log LH/ovulation test strip results and basal body temperature
- Discharge tracking to help you recognize fertile signs

How does Flo Health support me in pregnancy?
Once you conceive, switch to Pregnancy Mode for expert guidance.

- Pregnancy tracking with weekly updates on your baby's development
- Daily articles explaining fetal development at each stage

Can Flo Health help me with perimenopause symptoms?
Track changes during perimenopause with tools designed to help you better understand this life stage.

- Perimenopause Score to understand symptom impact on daily life
- Menopause Timeline to understand the perimenopause phases

Can I share with my partner?
Flo for Partners lets you invite your partner to support your health journey.

- Help them understand your menstrual cycle, get ovulation predictions, and celebrate pregnancy progress together.

Is Flo Health free?
The Flo Health app is free to download and includes core tools you need to track and understand your cycle.

What do I get with Flo Health Premium?

- Daily, tailored insights and expert-led videos
- In-depth pregnancy features
- Symptom Checker** that provides educational information on polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome, endometriosis, and uterine fibroids symptoms
- Fertility insights to help you feel informed on your TTC journey
- Secret Chats: Find tips from other members

Is my data safe with Flo Health?
Your health data is deeply personal. That’s why protecting it isn’t just a feature – it’s our foundation.
- Certified privacy and security: Flo Health is the first and only period tracking app with dual ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certifications, the international gold standard for privacy and security
- Award-winning Anonymous Mode: Turn on Anonymous Mode to use Flo Health without your name, email, or IP address being linked to your health data. No one can identify you in Anonymous Mode, not even us
- You’re in control: You can delete, access, and update your data any time, wherever you are in the world
Learn more at flo.health/privacy-portal

Note: Flo Health Premium is HSA/FSA eligible.

Medical disclaimer: Flo Health does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a method of birth control or conception aid. Predictions and features are for informational and educational purposes only. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical advice and guidance.

Flo Health period tracker is compatible with Apple Watch.

Download the Flo Health app today and join millions using a trusted period tracker, pregnancy app, and cycle tracker.

*As of July 2026
**Not available in the UK, EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, or Switzerland.

Privacy Policy: https://flo.health/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://flo.health/terms-of-service

Period Tracker and Calendar is an easy-to-use application that helps you track your cycle, ovulation, and fertile days. Whether you're planning a pregnancy, managing birth control, or just getting to know your cycle better, Period Tracker & Calendar is here to support you and take care of your needs along the way.

Period Tracker and Calendar is a CE Class I Medical Device (EU) intended to support tracking menstrual cycles and monitoring related symptoms. It processes user-entered data to generate predictions for upcoming periods and estimated fertile windows, so you can feel more prepared in your daily life with information tailored to your body.

→ Everything you need to track your period and health in one place:
Simple Period Tracker
• Log your cycle quickly with a clean, intuitive interface designed to make tracking effortless 
• Get predictions for upcoming periods based on your history and your unique cycle 

Comprehensive Health Tracking
• Track 100+ symptoms, moods, and activities
• See patterns and insights about your health over time, so you can better understand your body

Fertility & Ovulation Tracking
• Monitor your fertile window and ovulation days
• Helpful for planning or preventing pregnancy, depending on your needs

Pregnancy & Baby Growth
• Follow your baby’s development week by week, with guidance and tips along the way
• Track your body changes and pregnancy milestones

Perimenopause Support
• Track symptoms like hot flashes, mood changes, and irregular cycles
• Stay aware of your body during this transition

Personalization & Discreet Reminders
• Customize your app with color themes and Dark Mode that fit your style and feel comfortable to use every day
• Set subtle, customizable reminders for periods, ovulation, or medication that keep your personal life private

Privacy and Data Protection
• Lock your app with a password to keep your data private - your information stays yours
• Back up and restore your data easily on a new device, so nothing important is lost

Key features:
- Easy-to-read calendar to visualize non-fertile, fertile, ovulation, expected period and period day
- Daily tracking to log flow, symptoms, moods, temperature, weight, medicine, PMS, notes, and more
- Clear insights into your cycle and health patterns
- Timely reminders to stay on top of your periods, ovulation, fertile days, and medication
- Quick backup and restore to keep your data safe and pick up where you left off on any device.

Pregnancy Mode
Follow your baby’s growth and your body changes week by week
Get weekly insights and tips to support you throughout your pregnancy
Track symptoms and milestones in one place
Generate and share reports with your doctor easily

Perimenopause Mode
Track symptoms like hot flashes, sleep changes, mood shifts, and irregular cycles
See how your cycle and symptoms change
Gain clearer insight into your body during this transition

Flexible tracking options that adapt to your needs
- Adjust prediction intervals for irregular or changing cycles 
- Adjust luteal phase length if you track and log ovulation
- Log cervical observations for fertility tracking 

Simple Mode
- Hide ovulation, fertility and related data
- Ideal for teens and users who prefer simple tracking

! Important !
This application does not provide medical diagnosis or medical advice and is not intended as a substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional. It should not be used as the sole method of contraception, for pregnancy prevention, fertility treatment management, or for diagnosing or treating any medical condition. Predictions and insights are estimates based on user-entered data and natural biological variability may affect accuracy.

Simple, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed, Period Tracker and Calendar supports you through every stage — from cycle tracking to pregnancy and perimenopause. Download today to stay informed and keep track of your health with confidence.
